input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 auto-renews for successive one-year terms (renewal length is acceptable) but the only exit is ninety (90) days' written notice, which exceeds the fallback maximum 60-day non-renewal notice window. We therefore edit to the fallback level, shortening the window to sixty (60) days. The fee is fixed at 30% of Net Sales with no renewal uplift mechanic, so the price-increase cap element is not engaged; the preferred-only reminder mechanic and CPI/3% cap are noted only, not redlined.

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than 60 days.
If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at 5 percent.
mappings.quote: The Company shall pay HDI thirty percent (3016) of the Net Sales in excess of Eleven Thousand Dollars ($11,000) per calendar month.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We shortened the non-renewal/termination notice window in Section 4.1 from ninety to sixty days so the annual auto-renewal can be exited within our fallback 60-day window; the one-year renewal term and absence of any price uplift are already acceptable.
proposal.summary: Shorten the non-renewal notice window from 90 to 60 days.
